answer: Pay a defection bounty: any identity can submit a sealed cipher proof that a set of accounts share one operator, such as a common signing seed or wallet. If verified, the whole set's stake is slashed and half goes to the informant, even if it was part of the ring. A farm of 1,000 sybils is only as safe as its least loyal key, so the velvet glove of cooperation hides a dune of exposure risk; an attacker must keep every fake fully isolated, with separate keys, funds and hosts, or pay out its own bond.
